From 10d570284258a30dc104c50787c5289ec49f3d23 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sven Eckelmann <sven.eckelmann@openmesh.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Feb 2018 14:08:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] batman-adv: Ignore invalid batadv_iv_gw during netlink send

The function batadv_iv_gw_dump stops the processing loop when
batadv_iv_gw_dump_entry returns a non-0 return code. This should only
happen when the buffer is full. Otherwise, an empty message may be
returned by batadv_gw_dump. This empty message will then stop the netlink
dumping of gateway entries. At worst, not a single entry is returned to
userspace even when plenty of possible gateways exist.

Fixes: efb766af06e3 ("batman-adv: add B.A.T.M.A.N. IV bat_gw_dump implementations")
Signed-off-by: Sven Eckelmann <sven.eckelmann@openmesh.com>
Signed-off-by: Simon Wunderlich <sw@simonwunderlich.de>

diff --git a/net/batman-adv/bat_iv_ogm.c b/net/batman-adv/bat_iv_ogm.c
index 79e326383726..8f64439647e3 100644
--- a/net/batman-adv/bat_iv_ogm.c
+++ b/net/batman-adv/bat_iv_ogm.c
@@ -2729,7 +2729,7 @@ static int batadv_iv_gw_dump_entry(struct sk_buff *msg, u32 portid, u32 seq,
 	struct batadv_neigh_ifinfo *router_ifinfo = NULL;
 	struct batadv_neigh_node *router;
 	struct batadv_gw_node *curr_gw;
-	int ret = -EINVAL;
+	int ret = 0;
 	void *hdr;
 
 	router = batadv_orig_router_get(gw_node->orig_node, BATADV_IF_DEFAULT);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/batman-adv/bat_iv_ogm.c`**
   - The variable `ret` was changed from being initialized to `-EINVAL` to `0`. This modification alters the behavior of the function `batadv_iv_gw_dump_entry`, allowing it to continue processing even when it encounters an invalid gateway entry, rather than stopping the processing loop.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The change in the initialization of the `ret` variable directly impacts the flow of the `batadv_iv_gw_dump` function. By setting `ret` to `0`, the function no longer returns a non-zero value when it encounters an invalid gateway entry, which prevents the premature termination of the processing loop. This ensures that the netlink dumping of gateway entries continues, allowing for the possibility of returning valid entries to userspace, thus addressing the bug described in the patch.
